DGCA Probes Air India Hijack Alert Incident

The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) is investigating an incident involving a false hijack alert on an Air India flight from Frankfurt to Delhi. Civil Aviation Minister M. Venkaiah Naidu stated that the DGCA is probing the matter and that a review of security norms will only occur after the final report is submitted.
